Live Maya JWT/session and durable verified Client link through ClientChannelRuntimeService.resolve, with source identity/consent locks, merged/unresolved identity refusal, and current ClientConsentFact/effectiveClientConsents projection.
Privacy and marketing decisions only. NOT_GRANTED deliberately does not distinguish declined/withdrawn/invalidated beyond the explicit invalidated flag; no unsupported source meaning is invented.

POST /privacy/consents/export/qualification accepts exact canonical UTC from/to only and re-resolves own-subject authority. It always returns available=false, STEP_UP_UNAVAILABLE. Caller claims, range reuse, request IDs or ordinary session/role cannot create export authority.

Source-only register projection reads every own-subject ClientConsentFact in occurredAt [from,to), ordered by occurredAt/createdAt/id with full original source/actor/execution and invalidation provenance. No pagination, cap, current-effective filter or conversation-history dependency. No production transport invokes this projection.
